tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: List every country (ISO code, name, number of networks) and every module or device (id, name, kind) Band Atlas covers. Call this first if you are unsure of a country code or a device id.

tools.name: get_country_networks
tools.description: Mobile networks of one country: their 4G/LTE and 5G/NR bands (each marked cross-checked by two independent sources or single-source), core bands, and the state of 2G, 3G, 5G SA, RedCap, LTE-M and NB-IoT, with switch-off dates.

tools.name: check_device
tools.description: Verdict (good, limited or no) for a known module or device on every network of a country, with the LTE and NR bands it lacks. Use list_coverage for device ids, or check_bands for a device that is not listed.

tools.name: check_bands
tools.description: Paste the LTE (and optionally 5G NR) bands of any cellular module or device and get a verdict on every network of one or more countries, with the bands it lacks, using the same rules as Band Atlas: bands cross-checked by two sources are scored, coverage bands under 1 GHz weigh double, good needs at

tools.name: find_devices
tools.description: Rank the modules and devices in Band Atlas by how many networks of the given countries rate them good, and say which device works well on every network of each country. Useful to pick the fewest SKUs for a multi-country deployment.

tools.name: project_report
tools.description: One report for a device across several target countries: where it works as is, where it needs attention (with the indoor-coverage risk when a network's own coverage band is missing) and where it does not work, plus a link to the full report on the website (PDF, share link, ask an engineer to confirm

tools.name: iot_readiness
